title: Coffee Scrub
body: Experience the goodness of our Cauvery Peak coffees in a rejuvenating scrub. Finely ground coffee gently exfoliates to remove dead skin cells and stimulate circulation, while nourishing oils soften and hydrate. The result is skin that feels smoother, brighter, and naturally refreshed. Infused with pure essential oils, each variant — Orange, Eucalyptus, and Pine — brings its own unique touch of vitality, crafted to awaken both skin and senses. From our estate to your self-care ritual, it’s nature’s care. A natural skin exfoliator, softener and toner. Orange Coffee Scrub: Bright, zesty notes of orange uplift the senses while coffee grains polish the skin, leaving it soft, energized, and radiant. Eucalyptus Coffee Scrub: Cool eucalyptus clears and refreshes, blending with coffee to gently cleanse and revive tired skin. Pine Coffee Scrub: Crisp pine essence grounds and restores, paired with coffee for a smooth, nourished, and refreshed feel. How to Use 1. Take a small amount of scrub in your palm. 2. Apply to damp skin and massage gently in circular motions. 3. Focus on rough areas like elbows, knees, feet and nose. 4. Rinse off thoroughly with warm water. 5. Pat dry and follow with your favorite moisturizer.

title: COFFEE EXPERIENCE TOUR
body: Experience coffee at its source at the Cauvery Peak Coffee Estate Tour. On this 75-minute guided journey through a 150-year-old plantation, you’ll explore scenic peaks, valleys and lakes while tracing the bean-to-cup story. Travel in your own vehicle on all-weather roads as a coffee guide shares the estate’s history and craft. Stop at key points like the Wet Mill, Dry Mill, Roasting & Grinding unit, Estate Museum, and Café, where the journey ends with the aroma of fresh coffee. Perfect for families, nature lovers, and coffee enthusiasts alike, this tour blends breathtaking landscapes with the fascinating world of coffee making.

title: SHEVAROYS
body: Shevaroys Single Estate Reserve coffee comes to you from the high altitude estate of the Shevaroys. The rich bauxite soil lends to the unique flavour profile of the coffee in addition to the elevation of its location at over 1450mts/ 4800 ft. Shevaroys Reserve coffee is a uniquely curated product with limited production. Productivity is high due to rich soil, conducive micro climatic conditions and intensive cultural practices. The rich bauxite soil, perennial water and elevation produces a sharp flavour profile for discerning coffee enthusiasts.

title: NUTMEG & MACE
body: Nutmeg is a popular spice having a long list of health benefits, including its ability to relieve pain, soothe indigestion, and improve cognitive function. It extends its ability to detoxify the body, boost skin quality, alleviate oral conditions, and reduce insomnia. Nutmeg strengthens the immune system and improves blood circulation as well. It has a lot of vitamins and minerals and organic compounds related to essential oils. These beneficial components include dietary fiber, thiamin, vitamin B6, folate, magnesium, copper, and macelignan.
